headline: Updates on Balch Playground, Holcroft Park splashpad, Gillis Park pavilion, and Round 13 and 14 applications.
summary: The Gillis Park pavilion and entrance carries a $200K earmark, and Round 13 work includes ordering equipment and seeking bids for court replacements. Obear Park, Cooney Field, and McPherson Youth Center were all deemed eligible to submit full Round 14 applications.
items: Assistant director's report: past months' summary and upcoming classes and events
Director's report, including events, budget, fields, and projects
Balch Playground Phase 2, with a Cummings Donation
Gillis Park pavilion and entrance ($200K earmark)
Round 13 applications for Ahearn Park, Bartlett Gardens, and Gillis Basketball: ordering equipment and bids for court replacements
Round 14 applications for Obear Park, Cooney Field, and McPherson Youth Center: all deemed eligible to submit full applications
Abbott St. ROW and Independence Park (out-of-cycle CPC)
Ongoing projects, including AEDs, Beverly in Bloom, and Lynch Park Resiliency
Commission reports from the golf and tennis commission, Community Preservation Committee, and Open Space and Recreation Committee
location: Beverly Senior Center, 90 Colon Street, Beverly
